title: Prove E8 star-decoder puncture thresholds through 35 deleted lines
body:
PR620 reports sampled or annealed screens for deeper E8 punctures and non-root ports. This contribution supplies a finite exact census and a Weyl-chamber proof covering all root flats.

**Result:** no puncture of at most 35 of the 120 E8 root lines improves the star label-decoder copy-cost/live-port ratio **63/111**. The sharp minimum deletions needed for a nonzero reader to reach rational rank at most d=0,...,7 are **[56,55,53,50,44,36,26,1]**. It also proves the previously sampled **14-puncture** obstruction for every non-root normal; the sharp D7 deletion has root-only star cost 64 on 106 surviving ports.

The proof reduces arbitrary root-spanned flats to standard parabolic flats and handles arbitrary non-root normals separately. The verifier exhausts 255 standard flats and 511 nonzero reader supports, checking label/parity equivariance under all 8 Weyl generators. Exact greedy basis selection supplies sharp controls. This is a scoped negative result for star label decoders, not a new supplier, κ improvement or obstruction to general pairing-rank decoders or helper savings.

Changes are confined to `research/e8-continuation-20261013/punctures/`. The proof, deterministic receipt, source pins, prior-work attribution, Apache-2.0 notice and substantial OpenAI Codex assistance disclosure are included.

Validation:
- Exact standard-library verifier and geometry/parity/flat corruption controls pass on Python 3.9 and 3.14; regenerated receipts are byte-identical.
- Optimized Python is refused before any output receipt is written; the refusal has a negative control.
- Independent mathematical/code review confirmed the exhaustive reduction, thresholds and ratio theorem. Its minor citation correction was applied.
- `git diff --check` passes. Full repository `make verify` was attempted separately on the unchanged base with system Python 3.9; it stops in the inherited producer because `int.bit_count()` requires a newer interpreter. No full-suite pass is claimed.

```sh
python3 -B research/e8-continuation-20261013/punctures/verify.py --negative-controls --write /tmp/e8-puncture-results.json
cmp research/e8-continuation-20261013/punctures/results.json /tmp/e8-puncture-results.json
```
